name: Farmer
description: Tends crops and livestock; primary food producer.

name: Gatherer
description: Collects wild food, herbs, and wood from surrounding lands.

name: Guard
description: Protects settlement, patrols roads, defends against threats.

name: Crafter
description: Produces tools, cloth, and goods from raw materials.

name: Healer
description: Tends the sick; produces and dispenses medicine.

name: Merchant
description: Trades goods between settlements; brings coin and rare items.

name: Scholar
description: Studies Hearthwell anomalies and teaches skills.

name: Civic Officer
description: Maintains public morale and governance functions.

name: Adventurer
description: Explores, maps, clears threats, brings rare resources.
